subject.title: DuckDuckGo (requiresCredential=false) is never auto-selected as web_search provider even when enabled

question: Should OpenClaw reverse the shipped explicit opt-in policy and allow managed `web_search` to implicitly select key-free providers such as DuckDuckGo when no credentialed provider is configured?
rationale: Current main, docs, tests, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93616 intentionally keep key-free providers explicit because changing this affects provider routing and outbound search-data sharing.

options.title: Keep explicit opt-in
options.body: Leave keyless providers explicit and handle the UX through diagnostics/setup guidance; this matches current docs and shipped policy.

options.title: Approve implicit keyless fallback
options.body: Land a policy-aligned fix only if runtime metadata, docs, setup behavior, tests, and real behavior proof are updated together.

options.title: Close the candidate PR
options.body: If the policy should not change, close the implementation PR and keep the existing workaround plus diagnostics path.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Leave keyless providers explicit and handle the UX through diagnostics/setup guidance; this matches current docs and shipped policy.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged key-free `web_search` opt-in policy this issue asks to reverse.
